summary: Frontend testing of 'Modificar (Nueva Versión)' feature for quotes. Wizard opens correctly with title and warning message, but setup/recurring items are NOT displayed due to TWO critical bugs: 1) mapService field mapping incorrect 2) isHeaderComplete blocks display when integrator/pinpad/sponsor_bank not populated.

ui_bugs.issue: mapService function maps to wrong field names. Uses 'name' instead of 'medio_pago_name', missing 'tarifa' field. Wizard expects: medio_pago_name, cantidad_cajas, cantidad_bancos, tarifa
isHeaderComplete requires integrator_id, pinpad_id, sponsor_bank_id - but existing quotes may not have these populated. This blocks display of setup/recurring sections even when items are loaded.
ui_bugs.fix_required: Either: 1) Populate integrator/pinpad/sponsor_bank in edit mode OR 2) Create separate isItemsVisible condition that doesn't require these fields when isEditing=true

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility issue

dropdown_menu_modificar.description: 'Modificar (Nueva Versión)' option present in dropdown menu for implementation quotes

wizard_title_edit_mode.description: Wizard title shows 'Modificar Cotización (Nueva Versión)' when isEditing=true

wizard_warning_message.description: Yellow warning message displayed: 'Está editando una cotización existente. Al guardar se creará una nueva versión con número correlativo diferente.'

setup_items_displayed.description: Setup items NOT displayed in wizard - mapService maps to wrong field names and isHeaderComplete blocks display
setup_items_displayed.root_cause: 1) mapService uses 'name' but wizard expects 'medio_pago_name' 2) isHeaderComplete requires integrator_id/pinpad_id/sponsor_bank_id which are null

recurring_items_displayed.description: Recurring items NOT displayed - same root cause as setup_items

save_creates_new_version.description: Could not test save functionality as items not visible to verify

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix mapService in handleEditQuote (line ~1146): Change 'name' to 'medio_pago_name', add 'tarifa: s.unit_price_usd || 0'
CRITICAL: Fix isHeaderComplete validation or add bypass for edit mode - existing quotes don't have integrator_id/pinpad_id/sponsor_bank_id populated
After fixes, re-test: 1) Setup items display with correct names/values, 2) Recurring items display, 3) Save creates new version
critical_code_review_comments: handleEditQuote (line 1146-1154): mapService maps item_name to 'name' but wizard template uses 'medio_pago_name' - items won't display
isHeaderComplete (line 1399-1405): Requires integrator_id && pinpad_id && sponsor_bank_id which are null for existing quotes
Conditional render (line 2155): {isHeaderComplete && quoteData.setup_items.length > 0 && ...} - this prevents items from displaying
Need to either: a) Make integrator/pinpad/sponsor fields optional for edit mode, OR b) Show items section separately from isHeaderComplete for edit mode

rca_of_issue.issue: Setup and recurring items not displayed in wizard when editing quote
root_causes: 1. mapService function creates items with 'name' field but wizard template renders 'item.medio_pago_name'
2. mapService doesn't include 'tarifa' field - wizard uses 'item.tarifa' for pricing display
3. isHeaderComplete requires integrator_id/pinpad_id/sponsor_bank_id which are null in existing quotes
4. Conditional render at line 2155 prevents section from showing: {isHeaderComplete && quoteData.setup_items.length > 0 && ...}
reproduction_steps: 2. Click actions menu (three dots) for any implementation quote
4. Observe: wizard opens but only shows parameters section, not item tables
mitigation: Fix mapService: Add 'medio_pago_name: s.item_name || s.name' and 'tarifa: s.unit_price_usd || 0'
For isHeaderComplete issue: Either make integrator/pinpad/sponsor optional for edit mode OR add separate condition for showing items in edit mode
